title: de Loménie Brienne to Servien, 10 January and 1 August 1653; letter B undated in selected cipher pages (Français 5160)

steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 14/14 pages transcribed; 13/13 cipher pages deciphered; 1,356 elements, 1,308 identified (96.5%); 40 nulls ?, 3 unidentified, 5 cancelled. Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b9060495t/f24/full/1600,/0/default.jpg): f9r (canvas 24) after "ordres que vous avez receu": 36 60 33 n 39 x 21 , 6 28 ... -> de la co-n-du-i-te , que vo... = "de la conduite que vo(us)" with his table (36=de,60=la,33=co,39=du,21=te,6bar=que,28bar=vo); fits the f10r plaintext context. Excerpt f18r not imaged by me. Verdict: confirmed.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): no texts in the repository for George Lasry's result (only the report excerpt in lasry_entry.md); entry added with a summary and a note naming the missing transcription, decryption and key (needs contributor: George Lasry).

Verification 4: the read entry names no text file; looked for the reading in NOTES, lasry_entry.md, README and the folder: only Lasry's excerpt is here. Kept as an external pointer to George Lasry's decipherment (note added); not scored.

texts.summary: Savoy’s policy toward Spain and the proposed marriage of the Infanta; the Duke of Mantua, Casale and the Monferrat dispute. Brienne also reports army news, the fall of Bordeaux and the succession to La Vieuville in financial administration.
